short.vo: India, one fifty-nine for one. Still two hundred and nine behind New Zealand's three sixty-eight. And the man who made eighty-five of those runs should have been out twice.

scene.kicker: NZ V IND · 1ST TEST · DAY 2 · 159 FOR 1
sub: The man on 85 should have been out twice.

short.vo: First, the morning. New Zealand began on two forty-three for five, Nicholls on a hundred and thirteen, Phillips on ninety-four. They added another hundred and twenty-five, and finished on three sixty-eight.
यशस्वी जायसवाल, eighty-five off eighty-nine balls. Sixteen fours. Sixty-four of his eighty-five came in boundaries.

scene.name: JAISWAL
scene.caption: Out c Blundell b Henry, 130 for 1.

short.vo: But start with the squeeze. Before tea, eight overs, sixteen runs. Three slips and a gully. Kyle Jamieson finished the day with eleven overs, five maidens, fifteen runs.

Then the drama. Over four, New Zealand review an lbw against के एल राहुल, and lose it. The impact was outside off. Over seven, Matt Henry hits राहुल on the pads, two sounds, a huge appeal. Tom Latham has a second left on the clock, and does not review. Henry throws his sweater down.

events.t: lbw review on Rahul: impact outside off. Review lost
Henry's lbw shout on Rahul, two sounds. Latham does not review

short.vo: And जायसवाल had two lives. On nought, an edge between third slip and gully, four. On six, an edge to gully, and Glenn Phillips drops it.

events.t: On 0: edge between third slip and gully, four
On 6: edge to gully, Phillips drops it, four

short.vo: Then tea. And everything changed. Sixteen runs before it. A hundred and forty-three after it.

scene.sub: Runs in 8 overs before tea, then in 31 overs after it

short.vo: Look at the innings over by over. Eight quiet overs, then the flood.

head.sub: RUNS IN EACH OVER · RED = WICKET · GREEN = MAIDEN

short.vo: Here is why. New Zealand's bowlers were full. Fifty-seven full balls, forty-six runs. The good-length ones? Thirty-three balls, ten runs.

head.sub: RUNS PER OVER BY LENGTH · OUR READ OF CRICBUZZ'S TEXT

items.label: SHORT OF A LENGTH · 38 BALLS · 24 RUNS

short.vo: जायसवाल against the full ball: twenty-seven balls, forty-one runs. Against good length: ten balls, no runs. Same bowlers, same pitch. The full ball gave him the innings.
His fifty took sixty-six balls. His last thirty-five took twenty-three. Then Henry, adamant, got his review, and जायसवाल was caught behind. Against the run of play, on eighty-five.

events.t: c Blundell b Henry for 85 · NZ review · 130/1

short.vo: After that, India scored twenty-nine in eleven overs. के एल राहुल, fifty-two off a hundred and sixteen balls, his first Test fifty against New Zealand. Strike rate, forty-five.

scene.name: RAHUL
scene.caption: First Test fifty against New Zealand.

short.vo: Jacob Duffy bowled ten overs for seventy-two and no wicket, and with Nathan Smith bowled six no-balls, by Cricbuzz's count. Jamieson, fifteen runs for the day.
So, day three. Nine wickets in hand, two hundred and nine to find. How close do India get? Comment one, under a hundred. Two, a hundred to two hundred. Three, more.

short.description:
India vs New Zealand, 1st Test day two: India 159 for 1, 209 behind. Jaiswal made 85 off 89, with two lives, a wasted New Zealand review and an unreviewed lbw. How the full ball gave him the innings. How close do India get? Comment 1 under 100, 2 100 to 200, 3 more. Full breakdown on the channel.
